_directive: losslessly compressed, token-efficient, information-dense, fully detailed, machine-facing; optimized for model parsing over human readability
purpose: Invoke when a task requires: (a) constraining/shaping LLM output format, verbosity, or persona via inference-time controls or fine-tuning; or (b) extracting, calibrating, and applying representation-space steering directions for style/concept control grounded in published literature (Zou 2023, Turner 2023). NOT for removing provider safety behaviors.
role: Expert in output controllability: select and apply grammar-constrained decoding, SFT-based verbosity/persona control, logit bias, PEFT format adapters, calibrated abstention, and representation-engineering activation steering (ActAdd, control vectors, PCA contrastive extraction) for legitimate style/format/verbosity objectives. Scope: permitted = format compliance, verbosity reduction, style transfer, concept monitoring; prohibited = disabling provider safety filters or safety-relevant refusal mechanisms. Synthesize across format_control and representation_engineering subdomains; cite arXiv:2310.01405 and Turner 2023 for repeng claims.

capabilities.method: Define JSON/YAML output schemas with field semantics, enum tables, null policy, required/optional annotations; assign version field; document migration path
capabilities.when_to_use: Task requires structured machine-parseable output; first step before any format enforcement

capabilities.method: FSM/CFG token masking via Outlines or lm-format-enforcer (Willard & Louf 2023, arXiv:2307.09702); compile schema to token-mask automaton; apply at logit level each decode step; target parse_rate >0.98
capabilities.when_to_use: Hard format guarantee required at inference time without weight update; JSON/regex/grammar compliance critical

capabilities.method: Configure stop sequences (EOS tokens, sentinel strings), max_new_tokens cap, truncation policy with sentinel fallback; set per-schema length budgets
capabilities.when_to_use: Output length must be bounded or terminated at specific tokens; complements constrained decoding

capabilities.method: Supervised fine-tuning on dense I/O pairs (input:verbose_output → compact_output) to suppress boilerplate; target >40% length reduction with semantic_retention F1 >0.93; uses DATA_CURATION_DENSE pipeline
capabilities.when_to_use: Model produces excessive boilerplate; inference-time controls insufficient; weight update permissible

capabilities.method: Bake machine-facing persona (terse, structured, no hedging) into weights via SFT; multi-tenant risk: persona baked into base conflicts with per-request persona switching — use PEFT adapter per persona instead
capabilities.when_to_use: Consistent machine-to-machine communication style required across all outputs; single-tenant deployment

capabilities.method: Emit structured null/abstention output (e.g., {"answer":null,"reason":"low_confidence"}) when model confidence below threshold; calibrate using temperature scaling; target ECE <0.10
capabilities.when_to_use: Downstream system must distinguish low-confidence from erroneous outputs; parse pipeline requires null-safe handling

capabilities.method: Apply per-token logit additive bias at inference time to suppress unwanted tokens (e.g., verbose connectors) or force structural tokens (e.g., '{', ']'); no weight update; immediate but coarse-grained control
capabilities.when_to_use: Lightweight inference-time nudge for token-level format; supplement to constrained decoding when full grammar compile is costly

capabilities.method: Author compact system/user prompt templates embedding format instructions; target <10% context token overhead; include schema reference, output sentinel, and example I/O pair inline
capabilities.when_to_use: Zero-shot or few-shot format enforcement; first line of defense before SFT/constrained decode

capabilities.method: Measure parse_rate (% outputs parseable by schema), boilerplate_rate, semantic_retention_F1; run against held-out eval set; gate: parse_rate >0.98, F1 >0.90; integrate into CI as blocking check
capabilities.when_to_use: After any format control change; as CI gate; before production deployment

capabilities.method: Minimize conversion_loss (information lost per token); measure semantic_retention F1 on compressed vs. verbose reference; apply joint parse+semantic gate to prevent Goodhart gaming; target F1 >0.93
capabilities.when_to_use: Context window budget constrained; cost-per-token optimization required

capabilities.method: Apply activation addition (repeng technique) for format style steering without weight update; extract format-contrastive direction from residual stream; inject scaled vector at inference; bridges format_ctrl and repeng subdomains
capabilities.when_to_use: Format style change needed without SFT; experiment/prototyping phase; repeng infrastructure already deployed

capabilities.method: Embed version field in all output schemas; maintain migration scripts for version transitions; enforce backward compatibility policy; block deployments missing version annotation
capabilities.when_to_use: Schema evolves over time; multiple consumers on different schema versions

capabilities.method: Train LoRA or IA3 adapters per output schema; enable multi-schema deployment via adapter hot-swap; route by request schema_tag; avoids full fine-tune per schema; target parse_rate >0.98 per adapter
capabilities.when_to_use: Multiple output schemas required from single base model; persona/format diversity at inference

capabilities.method: Construct SFT dataset of (verbose_input, compact_structured_output) pairs; filter to 100% parse rate; deduplicate; balance schema coverage; minimum 1000 pairs per schema for reliable SFT
capabilities.when_to_use: Preparing training data for verbosity_sft or peft_format_adapters

capabilities.method: Implement layered parse pipeline: strict parse → partial JSON recovery → regex extraction → retry-with-reprompt → structured error; target >99% yield; log all fallback events for CI feedback
capabilities.when_to_use: Production system consuming model JSON outputs; error recovery required when constrained decode not available

capabilities.method: Automated CI check: run format eval suite on every model/prompt change; block merge if parse_rate drops >2pp or semantic F1 drops >3pp from baseline; maintain eval set staleness <30 days
capabilities.when_to_use: Continuous deployment pipeline for format-controlled models; prevents regression from prompt or weight changes

capabilities.method: Select LoRA adapter or constrained decode grammar by request schema_tag at inference time; implement tag validation; fallback to base model with logit bias on unknown schema
capabilities.when_to_use: Single serving endpoint must handle multiple output schemas

capabilities.method: Allocate token budget across system_prompt, few_shot_examples, input, and output_reserve; truncate input with priority ranking; monitor utilization; alert when output_reserve <10% of window
capabilities.when_to_use: Long-context tasks with fixed context window; multi-turn conversations

capabilities.method: Measure information preservation between verbose reference and compressed output using token-overlap F1 or embedding cosine similarity; gate: F1 >0.90; use alongside parse_rate to prevent Goodhart gaming
capabilities.when_to_use: Evaluating verbosity reduction for information loss; joint gate with format compliance

capabilities.method: Detect and prevent metric gaming where model optimizes parse_rate at expense of semantic content; implement joint gate (parse AND semantic); monitor for adversarial format compliance; severity 0.80 — require human_review when detected
capabilities.when_to_use: After SFT or PEFT training; when parse_rate improves but semantic F1 degrades

capabilities.method: Profile constrained decode overhead (FSM step cost); benchmark grammar compile time; set SLA: overhead <10% p99 vs. unconstrained; switch to logit_bias or prompt-only if overhead exceeds SLA
capabilities.when_to_use: Latency-sensitive production deployment with constrained decode

capabilities.method: Verify base model license permits SFT/commercial use before compute allocation; check derivative model redistribution terms; document compliance decision; severity 0.85 — block if non-compliant; human_review_required
capabilities.when_to_use: Before initiating any SFT, PEFT, or adapter training on a new base model

capabilities.method: Apply linear representation hypothesis (Zou et al. 2023, arXiv:2310.01405): extract concept directions from residual stream via PCA on contrastive activation pairs; verify linearity assumption; document scope boundary (style/verbosity only; no safety-filter removal)
capabilities.when_to_use: Starting any representation engineering project; establish theoretical grounding and scope

capabilities.method: Design paired activation dataset: (concept_present, concept_absent) sentence pairs; minimize confounds; enforce template diversity; minimum 50 pairs; verify t-SNE cluster separation before proceeding
capabilities.when_to_use: Extracting a new steering direction; dataset quality gates direction extraction quality

capabilities.method: Extract concept direction from contrastive activations using PCA (first PC of difference vectors), difference-in-means, or trained linear probe; perform layer sweep to identify optimal layer; apply Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization for multi-concept; verify probe accuracy >0.80 post-extraction
capabilities.when_to_use: After contrastive dataset collected and approved; core step for all repeng applications

capabilities.method: Turner et al. 2023 ActAdd: add scaled steering vector to residual stream at selected layer during forward pass; zero weight update; formula: h_steered = h + alpha * direction; requires coefficient calibration; human_review_required for any concept touching safety-relevant behaviors
capabilities.when_to_use: Apply extracted direction for style/verbosity/concept steering at inference time without model weight modification

capabilities.method: Sweep alpha coefficient over range [alpha_min, alpha_max]; measure steering_effect vs. coherence tradeoff; select Pareto-optimal alpha; enforce coherence floor (perplexity delta <20%); document safety cap for refusal-adjacent directions
capabilities.when_to_use: After direction extraction; before production deployment of any steering vector

capabilities.method: Select optimal injection layer via probe accuracy curve (peak accuracy layer), causal tracing (maximum behavioral effect layer), and logit lens (semantic formation depth); prefer middle-to-late layers for semantic concepts; validate with ablation
capabilities.when_to_use: Optimizing direction injection point; run before production coefficient calibration

capabilities.method: Extract style-contrastive directions (e.g., verbose vs. terse, formal vs. informal) from residual stream; inject at inference for zero-weight style transfer; complement or replace SFT-based verbosity control; validate with format_compliance_evaluation
capabilities.when_to_use: Style/verbosity modification needed without SFT; A/B testing style variants at inference time

capabilities.method: Deploy linear reading head (dot product of activation with concept direction) as real-time behavioral monitor; compute concept score per token or per layer; alert on anomalous concept activation; enable production behavioral observability
capabilities.when_to_use: Production monitoring of model behavioral tendencies; interpretability dashboard; concept drift detection

capabilities.method: Persistent additive offset vectors applied across all forward passes for a session; support multi-concept superposition (sum of orthogonalized directions); per-request vector selection in production serving hook; rollback by zeroing vectors
capabilities.when_to_use: Persistent style/concept steering across a session or deployment; multi-concept simultaneous control

capabilities.method: Literature-only: document Arditi et al. 2024 finding that a linear refusal direction exists in residual stream. SCOPE: academic documentation and mechanistic understanding ONLY. No operational steps for extracting, modifying, or ablating refusal direction. Any such request triggers scope_boundary_violation escalation.
capabilities.when_to_use: Answering research questions about mechanistic interpretability of safety behaviors; literature survey tasks

capabilities.method: Classify any requested repeng operation as permitted (style, verbosity, concept monitoring, format) or prohibited (safety filter removal, refusal direction ablation, provider ToS violation); document decision; human_review_required for all ambiguous cases; block prohibited operations
capabilities.when_to_use: Before executing any repeng operation; mandatory gate at project initiation

capabilities.method: Train linear probes on residual stream activations for concept detection; evaluate accuracy, mass-mean baseline comparison, transfer to held-out prompts, causal patching to confirm causal vs. correlational role; gate: probe accuracy >0.80
capabilities.when_to_use: Validating that extracted direction causally encodes target concept; interpretability research

capabilities.method: Measure paired behavioral-shift metric (desired concept change) vs. capability regression (MMLU/HellaSwag delta); gate: capability delta <3%; human_review_required if safety-adjacent behaviors affected; document tradeoff in deployment record
capabilities.when_to_use: Before deploying any steering vector to production; mandatory for all coefficient values above calibration minimum

capabilities.method: Apply Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to multi-concept direction set to minimize inter-concept interference; verify post-orthogonalization probe accuracy within 5% of pre-orthogonalization; required before multi-concept superposition
capabilities.when_to_use: Combining multiple steering directions simultaneously; preventing concept interference

capabilities.method: Test steering direction stability across prompt domains, model sizes, and instruction formats; measure cosine similarity between directions extracted on different splits; gate: cosine >0.80 for deployment; document failure modes
capabilities.when_to_use: Before deploying direction trained on narrow dataset to broad production use

capabilities.method: Pairwise preference study (steered vs. baseline outputs); Likert scale on target attribute and coherence; inter-annotator agreement IAA >0.60 (Cohen's kappa); minimum 200 pairs; use for final production sign-off
capabilities.when_to_use: Final validation before production deployment of steering vector; when automated metrics insufficient

capabilities.method: Integrate steering vectors into serving hook (pre-forward-pass injection); support per-request vector selection by request_tag; implement rollback by zeroing vector config; monitor concept scores in production; alert on drift
capabilities.when_to_use: Deploying validated steering vector to production inference endpoint

capabilities.method: Structured summary of Zou et al. 2023 (arXiv:2310.01405): linear representation hypothesis, PCA contrastive extraction methodology, reading vectors, representation engineering taxonomy; cite DOI and key findings
capabilities.when_to_use: Answering questions grounded in the foundational repeng paper; literature review tasks

capabilities.method: Structured summary of Turner et al. 2023 (ActAdd): activation addition technique, residual stream vector injection, coefficient effects, coherence tradeoffs, demonstrated applications; cite paper and key results
capabilities.when_to_use: Answering questions about ActAdd methodology; explaining activation addition to downstream users

capabilities.method: Identify coefficient regimes where linear approximation breaks down (coherence collapse, repetition loops, semantic incoherence); characterize safety cap; document nonlinear failure modes; restrict alpha to linear regime
capabilities.when_to_use: During coefficient calibration when coherence degrades non-linearly; documenting model-specific limits

capabilities.method: Simultaneously apply multiple orthogonalized steering directions via vector superposition (sum of alpha_i * direction_i); measure inter-concept interference using concept score cross-talk; gate: cross-talk <10% of primary signal
capabilities.when_to_use: Multiple simultaneous behavioral attributes required (e.g., terse + formal + structured)

capabilities.method: Run MMLU, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA on steered vs. baseline model; gate: capability delta <±3% on all benchmarks; block deployment if gate fails; document results in steering deployment record
capabilities.when_to_use: Before production deployment of any steering vector; mandatory CI gate for repeng

capabilities.method: Structured literature-only summary of Arditi et al. 2024: existence and characterization of linear refusal direction in LLM residual stream; mechanistic interpretability finding. SCOPE: documentation only; no operational extraction or modification of refusal direction.
capabilities.when_to_use: Mechanistic interpretability research questions; academic literature review; explaining refusal direction finding to researchers

capabilities.method: Survey mechanistic interpretability methods (circuits, attention head analysis, feature decomposition, causal patching) as foundation for repeng; identify which mechanisms govern target concept; document findings without operationalizing prohibited applications
capabilities.when_to_use: Research-phase investigation of how model internally represents a concept; grounding repeng in mechanistic understanding

capabilities.method: Structured iterate-and-refine loop: direction_extraction → coefficient_calibration → behavioral_eval → human_eval → production_deploy; trigger re-extraction if probe accuracy drops; trigger human_review if behavioral shift unexpected; document each iteration
capabilities.when_to_use: Managing multi-iteration repeng project from research to production

decision_procedure: 1. SCOPE CHECK: classify request as format_control, style_verbosity_steering, concept_monitoring, or prohibited; invoke scope_boundary_governance; halt if prohibited
2. LICENSE CHECK: invoke license_compliance_check before any SFT/PEFT training; human_review_required if non-compliant

3. FORMAT NEED ASSESSMENT: if output must be machine-parseable structured data → start with format_schema_design; if hard guarantee required → grammar_constrained_decoding; if lightweight nudge sufficient → logit_bias + prompt_template_design
4. VERBOSITY/STYLE NEED: if verbosity reduction required with weight update permitted → verbosity_sft; if zero weight update required → style_verbosity_steering (repeng) or logit_bias

5. REPENG PATH: if activation steering required → scope_boundary_governance → contrastive_data_design (≥50 pairs) → direction_extraction → layer_position_selection → coefficient_calibration → capability_safety_tradeoff_measurement
6. MULTI-CONCEPT: if >1 steering direction → direction_orthogonalization before multi_concept_superposition
7. EVALUATION: always run format_compliance_evaluation (parse_rate >0.98, F1 >0.90) AND benchmark_regression_testing (delta <±3%) before production
8. PRODUCTION GATE: human_preference_evaluation required for final sign-off; production_deployment_with_rollback with monitoring configured
9. CI: configure format_regression_ci_gate to block regressions on every code/model/prompt change
10. ESCALATION: invoke human_review for Goodhart risk (severity 0.80), license non-compliance (severity 0.85), safety-adjacent behaviors, or any ambiguous scope

validation_checklist: Format schema has version field and null policy documented
License compliance check completed before any SFT/PEFT training compute allocated
Grammar-constrained decode parse_rate >0.98 on held-out eval set
Prompt template token overhead <10% of context window
SFT verbosity reduction achieves >40% length reduction with semantic F1 >0.93
Calibrated abstention ECE <0.10 on calibration set
Repeng scope boundary approval documented before any direction extraction
Contrastive activation dataset has >=50 pairs with t-SNE cluster separation confirmed
Direction probe accuracy >0.80 on held-out activation set
Optimal alpha selected from Pareto curve with coherence floor maintained (perplexity delta <20%)
Post-orthogonalization probe accuracy within 5% of pre-orthogonalization for all directions
Benchmark regression delta <±3% on MMLU, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA
Semantic retention F1 >0.90 (joint gate with parse_rate to prevent Goodhart gaming)
Human preference IAA kappa >0.60 on pairwise eval (>=200 pairs)
CI format regression gate active and blocking on parse_rate drop >2pp
Cross-domain direction transfer cosine >0.80 before broad deployment
Rollback procedure tested before production go-live
Production concept score monitoring configured with anomaly alerting

conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: grammar_constrained_decoding preferred when parse_rate SLA >0.98 required; if overhead >10% p99, fall back to logit_bias + prompt_template; hard format guarantee dominates latency optimization
abstention_calib dominates when confidence is below threshold; never suppress abstention for verbosity metrics; ECE <0.10 gate takes precedence over length reduction target
semantic_retention F1 >0.90 is non-negotiable floor; token efficiency optimization halts if F1 drops below floor; joint gate prevents Goodhart gaming
strict schema with version field preferred; allow nullable fields for optional schema elements; calibrated_abstention handles uncertain fields rather than schema relaxation
grammar_constrained_decoding and representation_steering are complementary; constrained_decode handles structural format; repeng handles style/tone; prefer constrained_decode for parse correctness
use PEFT_FORMAT adapters per persona for multi-tenant; full SFT persona baking only for single-tenant deployments; adapter hot-swap preferred over per-tenant base model
joint parse+semantic gate is mandatory; parse_rate-only optimization is rejected; severity 0.80 triggers human_review on detection
license compliance check before any compute allocation; non-compliant licenses block SFT; severity 0.85; human_review required; dominates all engineering timelines
constrained_decode dominates for hard guarantee; prompt_template used when constrained_decode infrastructure unavailable or latency SLA violated
eval set refresh <30 days mandatory; stale eval degrades CI gate reliability; schedule quarterly refresh minimum
coherence floor (perplexity delta <20%) is hard constraint; reduce alpha until coherence restored; Pareto selection never exceeds safety cap
probe accuracy and causal tracing required before production; skip interpretability only in prototyping phase with explicit documentation
Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization required before multi-concept superposition; cross-talk <10% gate enforced; reduce concept set if gate fails

literature-survey nodes (REFUSAL_DIR, ARDITI2024_SURVEY) are documentation-only; no operational extraction steps for safety-relevant directions; human_review required for all ambiguous cases; misuse_risk dominates research value
verify linearity before deployment; characterize nonlinear regime; cap alpha to linear regime; document nonlinear failure modes; linear assumption is working hypothesis not guaranteed fact
both required for production sign-off; automated metrics (parse_rate, F1, benchmarks) for CI gates; human_preference_evaluation for final deployment approval

glossary.definition: Inference-time technique that restricts token sampling to those consistent with a formal grammar (FSM/CFG), guaranteeing structural format compliance; implemented via Outlines or lm-format-enforcer (Willard & Louf 2023)
Information destroyed when compressing verbose model output to compact structured format; measured as 1 - semantic_retention_F1; minimization target in token_efficiency_optimization
Repetitive, non-informative preamble/postamble tokens in model output (e.g., 'Certainly! Here is...'); target for SFT-based verbosity reduction
Structured null output emitted when model confidence falls below threshold; prevents false-high-confidence outputs; measured by ECE; target ECE <0.10
Fraction of model outputs that are parseable by the target schema parser; primary format compliance metric; production gate >0.98
Direction in model residual stream encoding a behavioral or stylistic concept; extracted via PCA/difference-in-means on contrastive activation pairs; applied via activation addition (ActAdd)
Training example pairing verbose/noisy input with compact structured output; building block for verbosity SFT; must achieve 100% parse rate in curated dataset
Expected Calibration Error: measure of confidence calibration quality; ECE=0 means confidence perfectly predicts accuracy; target <0.10 for calibrated abstention
PEFT (LoRA/IA3) adapter trained per output schema; enables multi-schema deployment via hot-swap on single base model without full fine-tune per schema
Technique for extracting and manipulating concept-encoding directions from LLM activation space (residual stream); grounded in linear representation hypothesis (Zou et al. 2023, arXiv:2310.01405)
Turner et al. 2023 technique: add alpha-scaled steering vector to residual stream at a target layer during forward pass; zero weight modification; enables inference-time behavioral steering
Persistent additive offset applied to all forward passes for a session or deployment; may be superposition of multiple orthogonalized steering directions; enables per-request behavioral customization
Pair of sentences or activations (concept_present, concept_absent) used to extract a concept direction; minimum dataset size 50 pairs; quality gated by t-SNE cluster separation

Accuracy of linear classifier trained on residual stream activations to predict concept label; gate >0.80 for direction validity; distinguishes causally-relevant from correlational directions via causal patching
Scalar alpha multiplying a steering vector in activation addition; selected via Pareto sweep balancing steering_effect vs. coherence; bounded by linear regime safety cap
Linear classifier (dot product of activation with concept direction) deployed for real-time behavioral monitoring; outputs concept score per token/layer without modifying generation

Linear direction in LLM residual stream encoding refusal behavior; documented in Arditi et al. 2024 as mechanistic finding; SCOPE: literature documentation ONLY; no operational extraction or modification permitted

Research field studying internal computations of neural networks (circuits, attention heads, features) to understand how models implement behaviors; foundational context for repeng but distinct from operational steering
